    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int n, a1, a3, a2, b1, b3, b2;
    cin >> n >> a1 >> a3 >> a2 >> b1 >> b3 >> b2;
    
    int min = 0, max = 0;
    
    // max calculation
    if (a1 > b3) max += b3;
    else max += a1;
    if (a2 > b1) max += b1;
    else max += a2;
    if (a3 > b2) max += b2;
    else max += a3;
    
    // min calculation
    if (a1 > b2 + b1) min += max(a1 - (b2 + b1), 0);
    if (a2 > b3 + b2) min += max(a2 - (b3 + b2), 0);
    if (a3 > b1 + b3) min += max(a3 - (b1 + b3), 0);
    
    cout << min << " " << max << "\n";
    
    return 0;
}
